240786248.epoch_kind: Selected phase-zero eclipse; deepest primary not assumed
240786248.interpretation: Seven measured eclipses include consecutive cross-sector cycles102/103 and170/171 after checking all five available QLP sectors17,57,58,84,85. Even/odd depths are confounded with sectors/apertures; they do not independently exclude an orbital double alias. Repeated morphology, actual spacing and Gaia period support the retained association. Depths depend on aperture dilution and local baseline. Pixel centroid uncertainties and timing systematics are not calibrated.

All available QLP sectors45,46,72 were inspected; earlier weak fits excluded, not used as timings. Earlier absence is not asserted as a clean null. Historical18.266535d period is not adopted.
